title: Scenario playbook: Hosted endpoints + adaptive model catalog quarterly roadmap
creator: Aisha Patel
project: Hosted API runway & Model Catalog Convergence
description: Objective: produce a scenario-driven quarterly roadmap that ties hosted endpoint rollout lanes to model-catalog readiness gates, capacity hedges, and OKR milestones. This ticket captures the planning playbook, decision thresholds for each scenario, required stakeholder approvals, and a phased execution plan for Q1-->Q2 handoff. Deliverables: 1) Scenario matrix (Conservative / Baseline / Aggressive) mapped to capacity commits and canary windows; 2) Model-catalog gating checklist and regression guardrails; 3) Route-level SLAs and fallback policies for hosted endpoints; 4) Communication plan for customers and sales; 5) Draft OKR contributions for the Platform and Product orgs.
acceptance_criteria: Scenario matrix with clear capacity and release triggers (conservative/baseline/aggressive)
Model onboarding checklist signed by Applied ML and Runtime leads
Canary schedule that aligns with Dedicated capacity hedges and autoscale limits
Risk matrix with mitigation actions and owner assignments
Published roadmap slide deck and customer-facing FAQ uploaded to Drive
decision_log: 2026-01-22: Agreed on 3-runway approach; conservatively require two successful canary windows before promoting a model to Tier 1.
2026-01-29: Decided that quantized variants will be allowed as fallbacks if full-precision variants exceed latency budget.
2026-02-12: Capacity hedging policy: 15% reserved burst for first 72 hours of a major rollout (P1/P0 customers only).
comments: 2026-01-19 Marco Chen: Drafted initial scenario matrix and shared with Runtime and Applied ML for feedback.
2026-01-25 Priya Rao (Applied ML): Flagged two models with known tokenization drift; added regression test requirement.
2026-02-03 Elena Torres (Customer Success): Requested a customer communication template for Tier 1 customers with rollback expectations.
2026-02-20 Runtime sync: Kernel scheduling improvements (ENG-2418) reduce p50 latency by ~8% in baseline scenario; update runway assumptions.
2026-02-24 Design review: Console rollout page mockups approved with minor copy edits (DES-1783).
rollout_plan: Phase A (Preparation, weeks 1-3): finalize model gating checklist; lock canary windows; pre-allocate Dedicated hedges.
Phase B (Canary, weeks 4-5): staged rollout to 1% traffic, monitor latency/cost/quality; hold for two successful windows before expand.
Phase C (Expand, weeks 6-9): ramp to Tier 1 traffic; open fallback variants and monitoring dashboards; sales notification for major customers.
Phase D (Stabilize, week 10+): post-rollout burn-in, QA sweeps, debrief and OKR measurement; capture any regression alerts for Optimize team.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Model quality regression after quantization. Mitigation: require regression evals with historical prompt-sets and automatic rollback triggers.
Risk: Capacity shortfall during aggressive scenario. Mitigation: pre-commit burst capacity for the first 72 hours and automated fallback to alternative region.
Risk: Customer confusion about model variants. Mitigation: publish explicit mapping (model alias -> variant) and customer FAQ.
metrics_and_okrs: OKR: Reduce hosted API median latency by 10% for Tier 1 endpoints (Stretch: 15%)
Metric: Canary pass rate >= 98% across latency/cost/quality checks
Metric: Model onboarding time <= 5 days from staging to canary
Metric: Cost-per-token delta within accepted band for quantized fallbacks
